question: Where can I find a nature reserve inside 80 kilometers from Memory Garden, Baltimore, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name AS name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), 80000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, NULL AS addr_city, NULL AS addr_state FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), 80000);
